rationale: The always-on-top-changed BrowserWindow event is named directly. Only prose and a documentation URL describe an absent BrowserWindow event. No executable setup, gist or reproduction repository is supplied. 50403 concerns changing always-on-top state under Wayland, not the missing notification event after a user action. The shared API family does not establish the same behavior. The unspecified display-server context and lack of reproduction do not establish an upstream cause.
